The '''Curator's Holocron''' contained the [[Gatekeeper/Legends|gatekeeper]] of a [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], his form shimmering in [[Color/Legends|silver-blue]] light. [[Gender/Legends|He]] had been tasked with maintaining the [[Dawn Temple]]'s records, overseeing its supplies, and guiding its daily life. Though wise and perceptive, he was the least prominent of the three gatekeepers, relying on the [[Warden (Dawn Temple)|Warden]] and the [[Jailor (Dawn Temple)|Jailor]] to unlock much of his own knowledge. He knew the history of the Temple and fragments of its secrets, yet his strength lay in memory and counsel rather than in authority or combat.<ref name="Lure of the Lost" />

When the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] fell and the Dawn Temple was abandoned, the Curator remained, diminished without his counterparts. He recalled fragments of the Temple's past but lacked the means to restore its purpose alone. To those who awakened him, he appeared patient and thoughtful, urging them to recover the lost [[Holocron/Legends|holocrons]]. Though burdened by the weight of time and loss, the Curator still guided seekers as best he could, a weary but steadfast voice echoing from an age long gone.<ref name="Lure of the Lost" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Curator's Holocron first appeared in ''[[Lure of the Lost]]'', a downloadable adventure for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2015]] ''[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny]]'' [[Star Wars Roleplaying|roleplaying game]].
